attributes.name: Druva - Successful Administrator Login After Multiple Failures
attributes.description:
Detect an administrator successfully authenticating shortly after several failed login attempts. This can indicate:
•	Password spraying
•	Brute-force attacks
•	Credential stuffing
•	Successful account compromise
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase:
Detect an administrator successfully authenticating shortly after several failed login attempts. This can indicate:
•	Password spraying
•	Brute-force attacks
•	Credential stuffing
•	Successful account compromise

attributes.query:
druva.feature:"Admin Event"
and
druva.event_type:"Admin Login"
and
(
    event.outcome:"failure"
    or
    event.outcome:"failure"
    or
    event.outcome:"success"
    or
    event.outcome:"success"
)
